set.prevailing_wage_basis: No LAHTF rule found; the March 12, 2024 staff report is silent on prevailing wage. City loans are public funds under Labor Code 1720(b), but 1720(c)(5)(E) exempts privately owned residential projects whose public participation is below-market interest rate loans with at least 40% of units restricted for 20+ years at or below 80% AMI (applied in DIR PW 2016-035, Spring Park Senior Villa). Where a loan is drawn from HOME program income, HOME rules (24 CFR 92.354, Davis-Bacon at 12+ HOME-assisted units) follow that money. Outcome is project-specific.
